revisions.text: Everyone looks at you and discounts your value, but not me. Complete the ritual and let me help you.
They call you a mistake, an abomination, but none of that is true. Complete the ritual and find peace.

The landwalkers do not understand what horrors await them if you fail today, but you are strong in heart and body. You will not falter. You will complete the ritual, and together we will kill the adversary.

The landwalkers  don’t understand what horrors await them if you fail today.  But you are strong in heart and body.  You will not falter.  You will complete the ritual, and together with The Hidden King you will kill The Adversary.
